title: Brian Warner - Magic Wormhole- Simple Secure File Transfer - PyCon 2016.mp4
summary: Brian Warner, author of magic-wormhole, presents the tool at PyCon 2016. He explains how a few secret words let two computers securely transfer files, covering the cryptography (NaCl, SPAKE2) and library use.
why: Recommended as the author's own explanation of the design and security of magic-wormhole.

quote.text: Author has a very good video on it at pycon-2016
